name: knowledge-space-codex
description: Portable Codex plugin for auditing, building, verifying, and diagramming Knowledge Space projects.

interface.shortDescription: Audit, build, verify, and diagram KS projects safely.
interface.longDescription: A stand-agnostic Knowledge Space toolkit for known-solution-first API work, portable knowledge-card reuse, fast deterministic Direct changes, adaptive project audits, single-writer subagent coordination, safe project-scoped edits, unbounded multi-area diagnostics, phase-scoped context packs, resumable handoffs, evidence lifecycle management, execution receipts, course and scratch-project reconstruction, browser-assisted verification, session-scoped dynamic IFRAME routing, external web-service contracts, and an offline manifest-bound KS backup to Diagramm JSON round-trip. The diagram workflow supports schema 1.2, semantic relationship normalization, read-only indicator and formula provenance, non-numeric indicator presentation as attributes, per-class object counts, source-bound change plans, structural validation, cloned-backup packing, and isolated restore/read-back gates. Planning, retrieved knowledge, handoffs, traces, and receipts never authorize execution: runtime actions use exact-approved flows, while destructive or live restore actions require separate target-specific approval.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose this cross-area KS behavior and prepare an evidence-bound plan.
Recreate or verify this KS course project.
Prepare a KS backup to Diagramm round-trip.
Configure per-session dynamic IFRAME routing in a KS dashboard.
Design a multi-user contract between a KS interface and an external service.
Apply this portable KS knowledge card through the smallest compatible route.
